_note: the owner's standards, as data. The code reads this file; it does not hardcode thresholds. Every rule carries a source so a rule can be challenged instead of silently obeyed. Change a value here and every module follows - no code edit.

gates._note: Hard stops. A posting that requires any of these does not get applied to by the system. It gets handed to the owner.

felony_free_text.source: AI Query doc HARD STOPS; the owner's standing rule
felony_free_text.why: A free-text felony explanation is his own words. No system writes it.

background_check_consent.why: Consent is an act by the applicant, not by a tool acting for him.

drug_screen.source: AI Query doc - not a hard stop

degree_claim.value: Trade Certificate or Some College; never Associate Degree
degree_claim.source: AI Query doc integrity note; the owner confirmed
degree_claim.why: An inflated degree is checkable and is a standard disqualifier.

never_list_employers.why: Sub-90-day stints, and an open IOSHA complaint CASE-000000 against one of them.
never_list_employers.replacement: ${staffing_period} - contract and staffing block, undated by employer

pay._note: Floors are gross hourly except dream, which is annual.

floor.note: same-day or weekly pay is the bar, not the rate

dream.source: the owner: won't switch under $65K+, dream is six figures

commute_radius_miles.source: AI Query doc; dream is remote-ok so no radius

expire_days.source: the owner: jobs are good about six months, two checks

per_bucket_per_run.source: the owner: three of each, four buckets, twelve a month

rotate_each_week.source: the owner: one bucket rests each week

clock_runs_when_employed.source: the owner: employment never pauses the clock

min_tenure_days.source: the owner: under 90 days does not go on the resume

short_stint.value: no dated entry; fold into the hands-on line

forms_require_full_history.source: omitting a job on a form is a disqualifier

agent_readable.source: elijah: Gmail is the address the system reads

aol.source: the owner opened it 2026-11-23; previously private, never monitored
aol.why: Personal inbox. Reading it is a standing exception, not a default.

answers_only_elijah_gives.source: AI Query doc; skill pitfall on inflating durations

idle_days.source: the owner: nothing like being idle too long

health_limits_come_from_doctor.source: skill pitfall; the owner has kidney disease - nephrologist is the only source
health_limits_come_from_doctor.why: Never infer what is healthy for a condition. Plan inside the doctor's rules.

cadence._note: How often each layer runs. The product owns its own clock; the host only has to call pulse.py. Intervals in minutes.

suggest.source: suggestive thinking should speak a few times a day, not once

token_watch.source: warn 2 days before the 7-day Testing cap, so check far more often than that

email_triage.source: the owner's standing order: every 3 hours

drive_organize.source: weekly is enough for file hygiene
